limitations: US early-hearing pathway; local service mapping required.

title: NICE NG233 OME under 12s
limitations: Applies under 12; three-month reassessment follows clinical assessment, not a blanket wait.

title: NICE CG128 autism recognition/referral
limitations: Under 19; SIGNAL records social-communication observations without diagnosis.

title: NICE NG87 attention assessment
limitations: Specialist assessment, impact across settings; checklist counts alone are insufficient.

title: NICE NG26 attachment difficulties
limitations: Children in/adopted from care; trained assessment required. Search-index evidence used; direct page returned 403.

title: NICE NG127 neurological referral under 16
limitations: Under 16 only; do not silently extend thresholds to 16–18. Search-index evidence used; direct page returned 403.

title: NICE NG76 child abuse and neglect
limitations: UK pathway; Pakistani reporting/legal obligations not established by this source.

title: AAP adjusted age for preterm development
limitations: Requires documented gestational age; do not infer prematurity from small size.

title: NHS attention in children/young people
